result: Eliminated in the first round (4th place)
opponent: Emmanuel Macron (re-elected), Marine Le Pen, Jean-Luc Mélenchon
detail: Received 2,485,226 votes (7.07%), finishing fourth behind Macron, Le Pen and Mélenchon and failing to reach the run-off. His first presidential bid as candidate of Reconquête.

vote_share: Reconquête won 4.24% nationally and zero seats
opponent: RN and other candidates in Var's 4th constituency
detail: Stood in the Var 4th constituency in the June 2022 legislative elections and was eliminated in the first round. Reconquête won no seats in the National Assembly.

role_sought: Not a genuine candidate for a seat (symbolic 80th/penultimate position on the Reconquête list)
result: Reconquête list won 5 seats; Zemmour did not take a seat
opponent: Rassemblement National (Jordan Bardella) led; Renaissance, etc.
detail: Marion Maréchal was the Reconquête tête de liste; Zemmour placed himself in a deliberately unelectable symbolic position near the bottom of the list. The list crossed the 5% threshold (5.47%) and won 5 MEP seats, but Zemmour was not elected. Days later (12 June 2024) he excluded Marion Maréchal from Reconquête over the legislative-election alliance dispute; most of the new MEPs broke with him.
